QF.id: VI Introduction to the Indian Capital Market_15

question.text: Under the PMLA 2002, market participants are required to report suspicious transactions to which body?

answer.text: Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), Government of India
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

explanation.text: The Logic: PMLA requires market participants, intermediaries, and connected institutions to monitor and report suspicious transactions to FIU, Government of India. Reporting is to the Director, FIU-IND. The Trap: SEBI regulates intermediaries but is not the recipient of suspicious transaction reports — that role belongs to FIU under PMLA. Note: Report suspicious transactions to the Director, FIU-IND, as the workbook prescribes.
